name: 飞客茶馆
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=飞客茶馆
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = api.flydigi.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ptf\.flyertrip\.com\/common\/cf\/.*.jpg/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/47\.100\.65\.202\/source\/plugin\/mobile\/mobile\.php\?module=advis/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www\.flyert\.com\/.*\.php\?module=advis/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www\.flyert\.com(\.cn)?\/.*\.php\?module=advis/i then reject_dict(200)
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/47\.100\.65\.202\/api\/mobile\/index\.php\?version=\d&mobile=yes&module=basicdata&type=forumlist/i then response.body.replace(/adv/, "fmz200")
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.flydigi\.com\/android\/v2\/ad/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/47\.100\.65\.202\/source\/plugin\/mobile\/mobile\.php\?module=threadpost&.+?&page=1/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/fly.js") with enable=${fwke_enable}, tag="飞客茶馆", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www\.flyert\.com(\.cn)?\/.*plugin/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/flyert.js") with enable=${fwke_enable}, tag="飞客茶馆", timeout=60, requires_body=true
